results.title: FastFlowLM: run LLMs on AMD Ryzen AI NPUs
results.content: FastFlowLM (flm) runs language models on the NPU of AMD Ryzen AI PCs. Its models are quantized weights in .q4nx files.

results.title: FastFlowLM models - Hugging Face
results.content: NPU model weights in the q4nx format, downloaded by flm pull.
